# Christopher Halmy and Christopher Bogart speak at ILFA's 2024 Conference


April 15, 2024


-
-
-
-


Law360 quotes Burford Board Director[Christopher Halmy](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-halmy/) and CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) from their remarks at the International Legal Finance Association (ILFA)'s 2024 Conference.


"'Today, money is expensive,' \[Halmy\] said. 'So having some type of alternative funding structures can be very interesting.'"
